I added a page to your Reading log note. The table is unchanged, and I haven't opened the page in the app, so I haven't seen how it looks.

- **Cards:** each book gets a cover-style card with a colored gradient, the title and author, star rating and finish date. They're sorted newest first.
- **Average rating:** shown at the top, next to the total number of books and how many you've finished this year.
- **Books per month:** a small bar chart.

The page reads from the table, so it updates when you add books. It follows light and dark mode and works on small screens.

The card colors are generated from each title, not real cover art, because pages can't load images.
